metadata.title: Synthetic Voice Dataset for Parkinson's Disease Classification using Topological Data Analysis, Random Matrix Theory, and Spectral Features
metadata.description:
This release contains the full set of synthetic voice recordings used for training the hybrid TDA–RMT–Spectral framework for Parkinson's disease detection. The archives provided here exceed GitHub's repository file size limits and are therefore distributed as Release assets.

The synthetic dataset is designed to approximate the topological, spectral, and random-matrix-driven properties of real pathological and control phonation. These data support the experimental study:

metadata.title: A Computational Framework for Early Neurological Disorder Screening Using Speech Signals and Embedded System
metadata.description: Interpreting speech signals as nonlinear dynamical systems provides a promising foundation for the early diagnosis of neurological disorders. This research concentrates on Parkinson’s disease and ataxia, conditions in which subtle alterations in speech patterns emerge as early manifestations of neurodegeneration. We introduce a diagnostic framework that integrates deep learning techniques with statistical signal processing, drawing upon concepts from mathematical physics, including energy minimization and stochastic modeling. metadata.title: Arabic Parkinson's Disease Speech Dataset
metadata.description:
This dataset contains audio recordings collected to investigate acoustic biomarkers and machine learning models for detecting Parkinson’s Disease (PD) in native Arabic speakers. Designed to support voice pathology detection, acoustic feature extraction, and cross-linguistic validation studies, it serves as a benchmark resource for speech processing and clinical AI applications.
